description.zh: 黑名单IP地址/地址段列表。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个黑名单IP地址/地址段。
description.en: The list of IP addresses or address segments to add to the blacklist. You can add up to 200 IP addresses or address segments.

description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website.

> A website forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. Call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance is added to the default resource group.

description.zh: 白名单IP地址/地址段列表。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个白名单IP地址/地址段。
description.en: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks for the whitelist. You can add up to 200 IP addresses or CIDR blocks.

title.zh: 设置针对网站业务的黑名单和白名单IP

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo config-web-ip-set --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --black-list 59.49.0.0 --white-list 2.2.0.0/24 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
